units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:1:9">Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הא דלא זָיְחָה דעתי עלי</he> (not <he>הזיח</he>) this happened because I am not cheerful (I am too poor to collect my thoughts).—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96b:4">Snh. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>קא זָיְחָא דעתיה</he> (Rashi <he>זָחָה</he>) he became overbearing.
